acceptance: PROVISIONAL; private browser overlay verified; RMS passes with median, shared-point and regional qualifications
limitations: Nine independent checks give RMS 88.18 m, median 75.66 m, P95 144.03 m and maximum 149.74 m. RMS passes 100 m; the suggested 75 m median companion bound is not met.

MacRae Point predictions on sheets 138 and 139 differ by 143.15 ground metres. This is one shared excluded physical point, not a whole-seam or footprint-gap measurement; neither fit was adjusted to force agreement.

Checks sample western lake cohorts and coastal headlands; urban/industrial, parcel-interior and most eastern offshore regions remain unvalidated. Grand Lake and other unresolved historical geometry were not forced into the fit.
Rounded cape and lake endpoints carry 12 px working source uncertainty; changed or ambiguous harbour edges and spatial correlation limit interpretation.
